newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 834 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 834 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 834 contracts compared with 1,713 overnight Sunday.
There were 78 wheat, 432 corn, 267 soybean, 27 soymeal, 23 soyoil, five corn calls and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 cent lower to 1-3/4 cents higher, corn was 1/2 cent higher to 1/2 lower and soybeans were 5-1/4 cents higher to 1/2 cent lower.
